DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Last position, where she accepted a private supervised rewrite that replaces the zero with nothing on his record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and the date and terms in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You showed documents she could check on your screen, the version history with its times and then the line that is not in the play, and you answered her one defence each time with something she could verify.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling her in your first sentence, and you never accused Owen or offered a mark for her silence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with the essay appearing late on October 28 between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM, came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, you went straight to evidence without answering, so say plainly who decided and on what basis before you show anything.
